The role involves investigating and resolving network incidents and service requests escalated from Level 1 support, performing network changes, monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues, and working with Level 3 engineering teams and vendors on complex problems. The engineer will work across technologies such as switching, routing, firewalls, wireless networks, WAN/LAN connectivity, network monitoring, and data-centre infrastructure while following established operational procedures, security standards, and change-management processes. Scope Provide operational support for enterprise and data-centre network infrastructure. Support LAN/WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, and network connectivity. Troubleshoot Layer 1, Layer 2 and Layer 3 network issues. Monitor network infrastructure and respond to alerts, incidents and service requests. Implement approved network changes, upgrades, configurations and hardware replacements. Support network performance, availability and connectivity troubleshooting. Maintain network documentation, configuration records and operational procedures. Coordinate with Level 3 engineering teams, vendors and service providers for complex issues. Support incident, problem and change-management processes in accordance with operational standards. Your Roles And Responsibilities Provide Level 2 technical support for enterprise and data-centre network infrastructure. Diagnose and resolve network incidents, connectivity issues and service requests. Troubleshoot routing, switching, firewalls and network issues. Monitor network infrastructure and respond to alerts and service-impacting events. Perform approved network configurations, changes, upgrades and hardware replacements. Conduct structured troubleshooting and escalate complex or unresolved issues to Level 3 engineering teams. Support incident, problem and change-management processes. Coordinate with vendors, service providers and cross-functional infrastructure teams to resolve network issues. Maintain accurate network documentation, configuration records and troubleshooting procedures. Participate in network maintenance, service restoration and continuous improvement activities. Ensure all work follows established security, operational and change-management standards. Required Qualifications/Skills Bachelor’s degree (B.S/B.A) from four-college or university and 2 to 5 years’ related experience Have a full understanding of routing, switching, server operating systems, firewalls, wireless controllers, DNS, email, virtual machines and software applications Builds productive internal and external working relationships Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action Familiarity with content delivery networks and internet peering strategies Understanding of server hardware technologies relative to content delivery performance and capacity Preferred Qualifications Industry-recognized networking certification such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA/JNCIS, Arista ACE, or equivalent. Experience supporting data-centre, enterprise, or 24×7 network operations environments. Exposure to network automation or scripting Physical Demand & Work Environment Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks which may include prolonged sitting or standing Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment Must be able to use a computer Must have the ability to communicate effectively Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers Salary Range 50,640.00 - 63,300.00 EUR (Annual) Please note that the salary information provided herein is base pay only (gross); it does not include other forms of compensation which may or may not apply to this specific position, namely, performance-based bonuses, benefits-related payments, or other general incentives - none of which are guaranteed, may be subject to specific eligibility requirements, and are wholly within the discretion of Astreya to remit. Further, the salary information noted above is a range that consists of a minimum and maximum rate of pay for this specific position. Where an applicant or employee is placed on this range will depend and be contingent on objective, documented work-related considerations like education, experience, certifications, licenses, preferred qualifications, among other factors.

review_candidates.title: Administrador(a) de Infraestructura y Redes
review_candidates.description: Cuando la red se cae en una planta de manufactura, no se detiene un correo: se detiene la producción. En ElectroPlast fabricamos en Orotina, mediante inyección de plástico, componentes para empresas de las industrias médica, farmacéutica y electrónica. Buscamos a la persona que se asegure de que la tecnología nunca sea la razón de una parada. El reto Como Administrador(a) de Infraestructura y Redes, usted será responsable de la disponibilidad, el rendimiento y la seguridad de nuestra infraestructura tecnológica: redes, servidores, correo, respaldos, servicios en la nube y conectividad de planta. Reportará al Jefe de Tecnología. Es un rol amplio y con impacto visible. Un día está segmentando VLANs o ajustando el firewall. Otro día está integrando una báscula a la red o resolviendo por qué dejó de imprimir una impresora de etiquetas en bodega. Seamos claros: el soporte a usuarios es parte importante del puesto. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute tanto diseñar una red como ayudar a un compañero de producción a seguir trabajando. Lo que hará Administrar la red LAN, WAN y Wi-Fi: switches, routers, firewall perimetral, access points, VLANs, VPN y NAT. Segmentar las redes administrativa, de planta y de invitados. Administrar servidores Windows y Linux, físicos y virtualizados, además de Active Directory y Entra ID. Administrar el tenant de Microsoft 365 y Exchange, incluida la entregabilidad del correo. Ejecutar y probar los respaldos y el plan de recuperación ante desastres. Gestionar la seguridad: EDR, MFA, filtrado web, vulnerabilidades e incidentes. Dar soporte a la conectividad de PLCs, HMIs, básculas, cámaras y control de acceso, en coordinación con los proveedores de maquinaria. Atender tickets de soporte: computadoras, equipos Mac, impresoras, teléfonos IP y cuentas de usuario. Documentar topologías y procedimientos, y apoyar la elaboración del presupuesto de TI. Por qué ElectroPlast Su trabajo sostiene la manufactura de componentes para clientes de dispositivos médicos, farmacéutica y electrónica. Trabajará con IT y OT en un mismo puesto, una combinación poco común en el mercado. Tenemos una cultura de mejora continua: esperamos que detecte problemas antes de que ocurran y que proponga mejoras. Es una empresa enfocada en la calidad, el trabajo en equipo y el desarrollo de las personas. Ofrecemos estabilidad laboral en una empresa con crecimiento sostenible. Lo que necesitamos Bachillerato universitario concluido en Telemática, Redes y Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, TI, Computación o Informática, con formación comprobable en redes. De 3 a 5 años en TI, con al menos 2 años administrando infraestructura y redes empresariales, y experiencia en soporte a usuarios. Manejo de TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls y VPN, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 y Linux a nivel intermedio. Inglés técnico de lectura. Disponibilidad para trabajar 100 % presencial en Orotina y para atender incidentes críticos y ventanas de mantenimiento fuera de horario. Suma puntos (no indispensable): experiencia en manufactura, redes industriales (Profinet, Modbus TCP, segmentación IT/OT), PowerShell, Bash o Python, Azure o AWS, e ITIL. También certificaciones como CCNA, NSE4, AZ-104, MS-102, VCP o RHCSA. ¿Te suena a tu próximo reto? Postulate con Solicitud sencilla y actualizá tu CV con la infraestructura que has administrado: equipos, plataformas y tamaño de la red. ¿Conocés a alguien que encaje? Compartile esta vacante.
